Against a deep navy night sky, a stylized cyberpunk city gathers around a crowded heart. An uninterrupted flat pale-blue ground plane carries it, with no roads, curbs, vegetation, or terrain detail. Broad empty blue gaps separate the inner neighborhood from roughly twenty detached high-rise towers in a much looser, uneven inward-facing ring.

At the center, roughly a dozen connected mid-rise blocks form a dense, irregular cross, packed around narrow alleys and small open courts. Dark brick, gray stucco, and muted red façades carry projecting window bays, balconies, exterior stairs, awnings, rooftop sheds, vents, air-conditioning units, railings, and rows of small glowing windows. Compact storefronts, glass doors, illuminated display windows, and vertical or horizontal East Asian neon signs line the ground floors. Above one courtyard, beside an open concrete frame, a chunky red-orange futuristic vehicle hangs suspended.

Most outer towers are simple rectangular residential slabs: repetitive bands or grids of bright white-blue windows, varied heights, and dark mechanical rooftop boxes. Among these stand several landmarks—cyan-lit glass towers crowned with vivid hot-pink geometry, a tall pink-edged tower wrapped in diagonal lattice braces and topped with antenna fins, and a few extremely tall, nearly black monolithic slabs at the outer edges, some leaning into or cropping out of view.

Outside the core, the composition becomes deliberately sparse and surreal. No continuous street network joins it together; isolated buildings and oversized dark slabs make hard boundaries for this floating city fragment.

Broad empty blue gaps separate the inner neighborhood from roughly twenty detached high-rise towers in a much looser, uneven inward-facing ring
At the center, roughly a dozen connected mid-rise blocks form a dense, irregular cross, packed around narrow alleys and small open courts

Dark brick, gray stucco, and muted red façades carry projecting window bays, balconies, exterior stairs, awnings, rooftop sheds, vents, air-conditioning units, railings, and rows of small glowing windows
Compact storefronts, glass doors, illuminated display windows, and vertical or horizontal East Asian neon signs line the ground floors
Above one courtyard, beside an open concrete frame, a chunky red-orange futuristic vehicle hangs suspended
Most outer towers are simple rectangular residential slabs: repetitive bands or grids of bright white-blue windows, varied heights, and dark mechanical rooftop boxes

Among these stand several landmarks—cyan-lit glass towers crowned with vivid hot-pink geometry, a tall pink-edged tower wrapped in diagonal lattice braces and topped with antenna fins, and a few extremely tall, nearly black monolithic slabs at the outer edges, some leaning into or cropping out of view
Outside the core, the composition becomes deliberately sparse and surreal
No continuous street network joins it together
isolated buildings and oversized dark slabs make hard boundaries for this floating city fragment

deterministic_rule_draft.prompt:
Against a deep navy night sky, a stylized cyberpunk city gathers around a crowded heart. An uninterrupted flat pale-blue ground plane carries it, with no roads, curbs, vegetation, or terrain detail. Broad empty blue gaps separate the inner neighborhood from roughly twenty detached high-rise towers in a much looser, uneven inward-facing ring.

At the center, roughly a dozen connected mid-rise blocks form a dense, irregular cross, packed around narrow alleys and small open courts. Dark brick, gray stucco, and muted red façades carry projecting window bays, balconies, exterior stairs, awnings, rooftop sheds, vents, air-conditioning units, railings, and rows of small glowing windows. Compact storefronts, glass doors, illuminated display windows, and vertical or horizontal East Asian neon signs line the ground floors. Above one courtyard, beside an open concrete frame, a chunky red-orange futuristic vehicle hangs suspended.

Most outer towers are simple rectangular residential slabs: repetitive bands or grids of bright white-blue windows, varied heights, and dark mechanical rooftop boxes. Among these stand several landmarks—cyan-lit glass towers crowned with vivid hot-pink geometry, a tall pink-edged tower wrapped in diagonal lattice braces and topped with antenna fins, and a few extremely tall, nearly black monolithic slabs at the outer edges, some leaning into or cropping out of view.

Outside the core, the composition becomes deliberately sparse and surreal. No continuous street network joins it together; isolated buildings and oversized dark slabs make hard boundaries for this floating city fragment.
